basic_details.job_title: C-DIT Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 30 Junior Machine Operator, Production Coordinator and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Centre for Development of Imaging Technology (C-DIT), an autonomous institution set up by the Government of Kerala, is filling 30 temporary posts on a 1 year contract or till the completion of the project, whichever is earlier, on consolidated pay of Rs. 21,070 to Rs. 40,000 per month depending on the post. The posts are Production Coordinator (1), Junior Production Coordinator (2), Senior Machine Operator (18), Junior Machine Operator (8) and Graphic Designer (Security Documents Production) (1), in the Hologram printing/production unit at Thiruvallam Campus, Thiruvananthapuram. content_sections.heading: About C-DIT
content_sections.text: C-DIT, at Chithranjali Hills, Thiruvallam P.O., Thiruvananthapuram – 695 027, describes itself as an autonomous institution set up by the Government of Kerala, functioning under the Dept. of Electronics & IT. It is an approved Total Solution Provider (TSP) and Accredited Agency for Government IT initiatives, and undertakes projects in IT/ITES, e-Governance, web development, digitisation and digital transformation. These posts are for shift work in the Hologram printing/production unit of its Optical Image Processing and Security Products Division.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 30 positions in total. The category-wise break-up is not printed. The number of posts is indicative only and may vary with the requirements of the client or projects.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Four posts have an age limit of not above 50 years on the date of notification; the Graphic Designer post has not above 55 years. Relaxation in the upper age limit is considered as per Government of Kerala norms for deserving categories, only if the candidate claims it in the application and uploads supporting documents. Qualifications from universities or institutions recognised by the Govt of India, Govt of Kerala, Kerala PSC or empowered academic bodies are considered. Candidates with equivalent or higher qualification are eligible and must furnish proof of equivalency. C-DIT reserves the right to decide the eligibility of any professional certificate or diploma not from a recognised university or institute. Each qualification route below pairs with its own experience, and the routes are alternatives (OR). 3 year Diploma in Printing Technology and 7 years' experience in coordinating press operations. OR NTC/STC/ITI/KGTE in Printing Technology (Press Work) and 8 years' experience in coordinating press operations. OR Plus Two / VHSE with 10 years' experience in coordinating printing operations. OR SSLC with 15 years' experience in coordinating printing operations. 3 Year Diploma in Printing Technology and 4 years' experience in coordinating press operations. OR NTC/STC/ITI/KGTE in Printing Technology (Press Work) /ITI and 6 years' experience in coordinating press operations. OR Plus Two/ VHSE with 7 years' experience in coordinating printing operations. OR SSLC with 9 years' experience in coordinating printing operations. 3 Year Diploma in Printing Technology/ Mechanical and 5 years' experience in press operations. OR NTC/STC/ITI/KGTE in Printing Technology (Press Work) and 7 years' experience in press operations. OR Plus Two/ VHSE with 8 years' experience in printing operations. OR SSLC with 10 years' experience in printing operations. 3 Year Diploma in Printing Technology/ Mechanical and 2 years' experience in press operations. OR NTC/STC/ITI (Machinist/Carpenter/Fitter/Electrical/ Electronics / Mechanic/ Welder/Printing technology or equivalent)/KGTE in Printing Technology (Press Work) and minimum 3 years' experience in press operations. OR Plus Two/ VHSE with 6 years' experience in printing operations. OR SSLC with 8 years' experience in printing operations. BFA /Bachelor's Degree in Graphic Design /Animation. Bachelor's Degree + approved Certificate course in Graphic Designing and two years' experience in graphic design. OR Plus two with Diploma / Certificate courses completed in Multimedia/Graphic Design/Animation from a Govt/ Govt recognised institution and 5 years' experience in designing in a reputed Institution. OR SSLC with Diploma in Fine Arts with 10 years' experience in designing in a reputed Institution. Preferences will be given to applicants having proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, CorelDraw, InDesign etc. Qualification and experience as possessed on the closing date of the notification are considered. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Pay for every post is stated as consolidated remuneration per month. Each post is a 1 year contract or till the completion of the project, whichever is earlier. The appointees have no claim for regular appointment in any C-DIT establishment after the contract expires. The terms and conditions and service benefits are as prescribed by C-DIT, and the selected candidate enters into an agreement with C-DIT in the prescribed format. The mode of selection for all five posts is printed as Written Test/Interview or both.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: C-DIT will decide the selection process based on the number of applications; it may include a skill test or interview. A committee constituted by C-DIT shortlists applications based on the Biodata and details of previous experience. Initial verification uses the application details and uploaded documents. Possessing the prescribed educational qualification does not by itself qualify a candidate; selection depends on the required professional experience and proven skills. Only shortlisted candidates are eligible for the written test, skill test or interview, held at centres allotted by C-DIT. Candidates may choose a test centre wherever permitted, but allocation is at C-DIT's sole discretion, subject to a minimum number of candidates at each centre. Candidates are shortlisted for group discussion or interview based on preliminary evaluation of the written or skill test, as decided by C-DIT. The final rank list is based on detailed evaluation and interview. No TA/DA is provided at any stage. Original certificates are verified when intimated.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in C-DIT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 30 positions: Production Coordinator 1, Junior Production Coordinator 2, Senior Machine Operator 18, Junior Machine Operator 8 and Graphic Designer (Security Documents Production) 1. The notice says the numbers are indicative and may vary.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for C-DIT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The closing date for online applications is 08.12.2026, 5 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the C-DIT posts?
faq.answer: The limit is not above 50 years on the date of notification for the Production Coordinator, Junior Production Coordinator, Senior Machine Operator and Junior Machine Operator posts. For the Graphic Designer post it is not above 55 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for C-DIT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 300/- (incl. GST) for each post. SC/ST candidates are exempted if they upload the caste/community certificate issued by the competent authority.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of a Senior Machine Operator at C-DIT?
faq.answer: The Senior Machine Operator post pays Rs. 27,920- 31,020/- per month (Consolidated).

faq.question: Q7. Is the C-DIT job permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a 1 year contract or till the completion of the project, whichever is earlier. Appointees have no claim for regular appointment after the contract expires.

faq.answer: A committee shortlists applications based on Biodata and previous experience. Shortlisted candidates attend a written test, skill test or interview as decided by C-DIT, and a final rank list follows detailed evaluation and interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the C-DIT posts be located?
faq.answer: The posts are in Thiruvananthapuram, at the Hologram printing/production unit at Thiruvallam Campus. The notice also says posting can be anywhere in client offices or project sites in Kerala.

faq.answer: The notice states the fee as Rs. 300/- for each post, which indicates separate applications per post. It does not otherwise address multiple applications.
